It was concurrent with elections to the [[United States House of Representatives]]. Incumbent Democratic U.S Senator [[John Glenn]] decided to retire, instead of seeking a fifth term. Republican Governor [[George Voinovich]] won the open seat.{{cite web|url=https://www.newspapers.com/clip/18250221/the_akron_beacon_journal/|title=Voinovich backs lengthier trial for Clinton|newspaper=The Akron Beacon Journal|date=January 6, 1999|via=[[Newspapers.com]]|page=10}} This was the first open-seat Senate election in Ohio for this seat since [[1920 United States Senate election in Ohio|1920]]. == General election == === Candidates === * [[Mary O.
